description: Domain-agnostic agentic workflow with deterministic context orchestration. Durable memory: docs/memory/*; AGENTS.md identity; .memory/* generated cache only. Design Contract is tier-1 for UI. Indie ship: code-loop and shape-lite skip full plan re-run.

designArtifacts.note: UI tasks: Design Contract is primary context for designer/frontend/judge. Does not replace scoped repo reads.

codeLoop.note: Bug/fix/small implement only. No plan rewrite, no DESIGN-GATE re-run. Escalate to shape-lite or plan-feature when scope grows.

shapeLite.note: Compact idea shaping for indie continuous ship. Produces NEXT recommendation; does not dispatch workers.

fullModule.note: Full brainstorm → plan → (design-spec if UI) → execute → test → learn. Use for new modules.

context.note: Hyphen paths are CLI entrypoints. Underscore modules are internal libraries. Context Packet is primary; agents may still read in-scope repo files.

orchestrationPrinciples: Context Packet first — prefer packet tiers over dumping folders
Scoped repo read allowed — worker-scopes.json bounds editable paths
Never ban application source reads required to implement or fix
Cursor-first runtime — multi-tool adapters are non-goals for this policy
Heuristic scores only — no ML ranker required
Indie continuous ship — code-loop and shape-lite must not force full workflow re-entry
Domain-agnostic — no product lock-in (e.g. AI Workspace); skills selected by intent + AGENTS.md
porting: 3. Treat docs/memory/* as durable SoT; regenerate .memory/* after AGENTS changes.
4. Use context-builder.py (hyphen) before every agent task.
5. UI modules: Design Contract template under docs/design/_templates/.
6. Indie day-to-day: /fix for bugs, /shape-lite for new ideas, /dev-module only for new modules.
